text_block_list.text: Right from the start of her training, Verxina had set the Oaks as her ultimate goal and proceeded with her preparations.
"Those accumulated efforts were steadily showing results—"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
For a 2,400m pace,
this time is...!
choice_data_list: Yeah, you've really grown a lot!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "I am strong. Right now, I'm probably at my absolute best...! The one truly worthy of being the Queen of the Oaks is—"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
None other than
myself!

Verxina is brimming with confidence.
Even so, the one opponent she can't help but be conscious of is, inevitably—

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
—Did you hear? Turns out they couldn't
fix the gym's strongest machine after all.

text_block_list.name: Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, for the girls who break even Umamusume-grade machines?
I see, so we still can't use it yet, huh..."

text_block_list.name: Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
...Then wasn't Gentildonna troubled?
It was practically made just for her, after all.

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
"That's so pitiful.
Didn't she get a bit sloppy with her final adjustments
before the Oaks?"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm.
What strange rumors are circulating."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Do you all honestly believe that—
and convince yourselves that Gentildonna
is merely under-prepared?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Even if you look at who I am right now...

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
...!
W-Where does that confidence come from...?

text_block_list.name: Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to you, you're known for your incredible power...
If the conditioning there isn't perfect, then―

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Imperfect?
No. —It is complete perfection.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It is quite simple.
I simply sought a new machine.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Machines with greater resistance and harsher demands... are what make this power of mine truly formidable.

text_block_list.name: Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Still, didn't it take time to find a machine like that?
I imagine making adjustments during that period was...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Hohohoho...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
What if... you trained three times as much
as an ordinary person?

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text: T-Triple...?! There's no way I can do that—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Oh?
Would you like to take a look, then?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Hup!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!!
A gasp escaped my lips. Gentildonna surged up the uphill course again and again, pushing both her muscles and cardiovascular stamina to the limit—

And with every step up the slope...
she gained even more speed.
The spectating Trainers all fall dead silent at once... That is how terrifyingly overwhelming the aura radiating from Gentildonna is.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
What else? There were probably those who questioned
whether she could even endure a distance of 2,400 meters.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure you don't need to ask whether she can handle
the Tokyo Racecourse track, given it's her first time taking it on?

Right then, suddenly...
Gentildonna looked over at Verxina.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe.
Oh, how pitiful.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: After the Oaks, no one... is allowed to have sweet dreams anymore.

The day of the Oaks... Verxina seemed
somehow bewildered.
It was because of the intimidation Gentildonna had shown.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I understand.
I really, truly do understand...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: However...—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"'It can't be...!!!!
To think that I... could lose...!
This can't be...!!!!'"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...No,
it is... nothing at all.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
No matter how strong she has become,
I have nothing to fear.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"I have steadily built myself up for today...
There is no conceivable victor other than myself!"
choice_data_list: (I feel like she's pushing herself too hard... but)

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text: “However, please believe in Verxina-chan's strength at all times…… and always watch over her.”

I'm worried about how Verxina is doing.
However, I decided to believe in her determination...
and cheer her on with words of encouragement.
choice_data_list: Show them everything you've learned so far with all your might!
Show them everything you've learned so far with all your might!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes, never again...
will I ever feel that way...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Nfufu~♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, if Big Sis wins today,
should we make an 'Oaks-y' flower crown?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Aaaand then, I'll give it to her as a present! ♡
Saying, "To the Queen!" How does that sound?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
How do you plan on making it out of oak?
Or rather...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Why are you always inviting me?
You've got plenty of friends, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "I mean, it's my big sis's race! Of course we wanna watch together as a family♡"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Even if we're called family,
we're completely different—"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah!!
Big sis is here!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Big sis—... Hm?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Doesn't Big Sis...
seem kind of strange?"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(It's okay. As long as I properly demonstrate
everything I've built up so far...—and yet...)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: (What is this... sheer intensity coming from her?)
